title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #15

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How can a child trust God when facing a challenge? (1 mark)
   A. Give up
   B. Ignore the problem
   C. Pray, read the Bible and ask for help from trusted people
   D. Blame others

2. What does it mean to say that God is the sole Creator? (1 mark)
   A. God had many helpers in creation
   B. God was made by someone
   C. God is the only Creator
   D. God made only the animals

3. Which verse in Luke says that John would go before the Lord to prepare His way? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 15:8
   B. Luke 1:76
   C. Luke 7:14
   D. Luke 19:5

4. Which is a result of a bad choice such as fighting? (1 mark)
   A. Injury and punishment
   B. More friends
   C. Better marks
   D. Getting a prize

5. What does it mean to fear God? (1 mark)
   A. To be terrified of Him
   B. To respect and love Him and obey Him
   C. To run from Him
   D. To ignore Him

6. What was John's main work? (1 mark)
   A. Preparing the way for the Lord
   B. Ruling Israel
   C. Building the temple
   D. Leading an army

7. What does compassion mean? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring others
   B. Being angry
   C. Laughing at others
   D. Feeling sorry for others and wanting to help

8. Who ate the fruit God had forbidden? (1 mark)
   A. Adam and Eve
   B. Abraham and Sarah
   C. Peter and John
   D. Joseph and Mary

9. Which of these is a righteous way of living? (1 mark)
   A. Cheating
   B. Stealing
   C. Telling the truth
   D. Lying

10. What does integrity mean when using a phone? (1 mark)
   A. Copying others
   B. Doing right when nobody is watching
   C. Wasting data
   D. Hiding things

11. What did Stephen see before he died? (1 mark)
   A. A lion
   B. A storm
   C. Nothing
   D. Heaven open and Jesus standing at God's right hand

12. Who first told Pharaoh about Joseph? (1 mark)
   A. A magician
   B. The cupbearer
   C. Potiphar
   D. The baker

13. Which of these helps to protect our eyes? (1 mark)
   A. Reading in the dark
   B. Throwing dust
   C. Staring at the sun
   D. Not rubbing them with dirty hands

14. Why is it important to care for personal items? (1 mark)
   A. They last longer and save money
   B. They are free
   C. They are unimportant
   D. They look bad

15. What question did Nicodemus ask about being born again? (1 mark)
   A. Who are you?
   B. How can someone be born when old?
   C. Where is Jerusalem?
   D. Who is God?

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Describe how Daniel made a right choice in Babylon and give two lessons a child can learn from him. (5 marks)

17. Explain how Luke 16:10 and Genesis 2:15 teach responsibility, and give examples from school and home. (5 marks)

18. Explain four reasons why children should honour their parents. (5 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Pray, read the Bible and ask for help from trusted people
   Trust in God shows in prayer and seeking help.

2. C — God is the only Creator
   Sole means only. God alone made everything.

3. B — Luke 1:76
   Luke 1:76-79 speaks about John's task.

4. A — Injury and punishment
   Fighting often brings pain, trouble and lost friendships.

5. B — To respect and love Him and obey Him
   The fear of God is deep respect.

6. A — Preparing the way for the Lord
   Luke 1:76 says he would prepare the way.

7. D — Feeling sorry for others and wanting to help
   Compassion moves us to help.

8. A — Adam and Eve
   Genesis 3 tells about Adam and Eve.

9. C — Telling the truth
   Righteous living pleases God.

10. B — Doing right when nobody is watching
   Integrity is honesty in private.

11. D — Heaven open and Jesus standing at God's right hand
   Acts 7:55-56.

12. B — The cupbearer
   The cupbearer remembered Joseph from prison.

13. D — Not rubbing them with dirty hands
   Clean hands protect the eyes from infection.

14. A — They last longer and save money
   Care reduces loss.

15. B — How can someone be born when old?
   He was puzzled about a second birth.

SECTION B
----
16. (5 marks)
   Answer: Daniel decided not to defile himself with the king's food and politely asked for permission to eat differently. Lessons: it is good to stay faithful to God even when far from home or when no one is watching; we can stand for what is right politely and respectfully; God blesses those who stay faithful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for describing the decision, 1 for politeness or asking permission, 2 for two lessons, 1 for clear expression.

17. (5 marks)
   Answer: Luke 16:10 says being faithful in small things leads to bigger tasks. Genesis 2:15 says God gave people work to do and things to care for. At school a child covers books and cleans the class. At home a child washes plates and looks after younger siblings.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each verse meaning, 1 for a school example, 1 for a home example, 1 for a clear link.

18. (5 marks)
   Answer: God commands it (Exodus 20:12); parents care for us; it brings peace at home; it brings God's blessing; it sets an example for younger children.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason up to 4, and 1 mark for a clear explanation.
